answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 400 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the prism log publishes the live set and the terrace audit records each lapse. Keeping 31 aliases alive therefore means 31 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the dune quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
